text: Figure 2.5: Example: Data flow in the scope of System Timing view In addition, a timing description in system view refers to the concrete communication of software components that only was represented as abstract connectors in VfbTiming view. Due to the software mapping, now communication is either local communication over the RTE (both software components on same ECU) or remote communication over the RTE, through the communication stack of the BSW and a communication bus. A system-specific timing description thus can refer to signals (RTE), I-PDUs (COM) and frames (communication driver and bus). [TPS_TIMEX_00034] Purpose of SystemTiming ⌈The element SystemTiming ag- gregates all timing information, timing descriptions and timing constraints, that is re- lated to the System View. ⌋ Class SystemTiming Note A model element used to refine timing descriptions and constraints (from a VfbTiming) at System level, utilizing information about topology , software deployment, and signal mapping described in the System T emplate. TimingDescriptions aggregated by SystemTiming are restricted to events which are derived from the class TDEventVfb, TDEventSwcInternalBehavior and TDEventCom.
